evals.name: discover-without-generating
evals.prompt: Show me styles for a Shanghai sunset photo. Do not generate yet.
evals.expected_output: Suggests up to three recipes with trade-offs and does not generate.

evals.name: choose-and-route-installed-style
evals.prompt: Choose the best Skillbook treatment for this quiet sunset and proceed.
evals.expected_output: Chooses one image-specific treatment and follows its installed Skill.

evals.name: unavailable-style-install-command
evals.prompt: Use a Skillbook style that is not installed in this session.
evals.expected_output: Does not approximate the style and returns its exact install command.

evals.name: separate-multiple-inputs
evals.prompt: Choose a treatment and process each attached photograph separately.
evals.expected_output: Routes to one style and keeps one independent output per input.

evals.name: do-not-intercept-named-style
evals.expected_output: Leaves execution to the named style Skill without comparing alternatives.
